findings.title: Unknown workspace-creation result loses request identity; retry creates duplicate workspace, first project and wallet

evidence.claim: Onboarding only guards loading/sign-in, omits explicit requestKey, writes selection only on readable success, and has no retained request/recovery.
Mutating requests without an explicit key generate crypto.randomUUID(); post third argument is optional.
AsyncForm catches unknown failure and resets busy, enabling a new submission.
POST network/unreadable JSON failures are CLIENT_RESULT_UNCONFIRMED. Exactly one transport attempt.
ErrorNotice displays text only; no receipt discovery.
requireUser, authority lock, current active user, replay(actor,tenant.create,key,body), then tenant/membership/wallet/project inserts in one transaction.
Replay identity is actor/action/key. Same key same body replays; changed body 409; revoked 410; a fresh key runs effect.
Authority lock serializes and checks status/auth_version; does not deduplicate workspace bodies.
Tenant/project IDs are generated, names not unique.
request_replays PK is actor/action/key, input_hash not unique.
Callback commits before result returns; callback errors roll back.
Existing membership with no accessible project has an explicit Create workspace -> /welcome link. Do not blanket-redirect all existing members.
Membership refresh selects accessible membership but does not resolve an onboarding creation attempt.
Receipt lookup is specialized for support.grants.create:<tenant>, not generic tenant.create.

reproduction_schedule: Fresh signed-in user submits the two required names at /welcome; post() generates K1.
POST transaction commits T1, owner membership, wallet W1, project P1 and replay(actor,tenant.create,K1).
Lose the response after commit, or deliver unreadable JSON: client reports CLIENT_RESULT_UNCONFIRMED before local selection is written.
AsyncForm clears busy; Onboarding retains no original body/key/result and allows the unchanged form to be submitted again.
Second click generates K2. replay does not match K1, so it creates T2/P2/W2. User enters second result instead of recovering T1/P1.
Refreshing /welcome also retains no original creation attempt. Existing memberships do not close this form; intentional additional-workspace creation remains a supported entry.
findings.impact: Duplicate enterprise/project/owner membership/wallet and lost result recovery. No duplicate paid task or charge claimed.
